summary_en: Nippon Thompson authorized repurchase of up to 916,000 shares (1.3% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥1.1 billion through open market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange between December 1, 2026 and March 31, 2027, to support total shareholder return target of 50% or above under its medium-term plan.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Nippon Thompson's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 916,000 treasury shares for a maximum of ¥1.1 billion through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The repurchase period runs from December 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The authorized shares represent 1.3% of the 70.39 million outstanding shares as of September 30, 2026.

The company undertakes this buyback to support its medium-term plan commitment to a total shareholder return ratio of 50% or above. The repurchase is intended to facilitate flexible capital allocation, enhance shareholder returns, and improve capital efficiency. No specific price ceiling was disclosed.
